description: AOS Configuration - Optimized based on Walk-Forward Testing Results

TSLA.notes: Only trade strong trends, high confidence required

GOOGL.notes: Evidence-based GOOGL profile with flow-only strategy stack and default L2-only gating.

MU.notes: Multi-strategy consensus config (2026-02-15). vwap_magnet + momentum_flow. Tuned on 20 L2 days from Oct 2025-Feb 2026 (94 total). Regime routing: TRENDING -> momentum_flow+vwap_magnet, MIXED/CHOPPY -> vwap_magnet. Consensus params from robust + trade_adjusted tuning (44 trials total). Anti-overfit: median values where metrics disagree.

adaptive_tuner_profiles.profile_name: MU C4BB C4x3 OOS v3 (Formula Guard Experimental)
adaptive_tuner_profiles.source_note: Experimental continuation of c4bb tuning. This profile improved prior 10-day holdout vs core baseline, but failed unseen validation on 2026-02-11..2026-02-13. Treat as fallback research profile; keep core as primary non-overfit selection.

adaptive_tuner_profiles.profile_name: MU C4BB C4x3 OOS v2 (Core Winner)
adaptive_tuner_profiles.source_note: Derived from c4bb2197e651 and validated on 8 OOS sessions (2025-10-01..2026-02-10). Core combo won by holdout stability (+4.0981 USD holdout) while formula combo showed discovery surge but holdout decay (-22.9486 USD), so formula stays optional fallback. Original c4bb remains untouched.

adaptive_tuner_profiles.notes: Derived from cross-day pattern mining (2025-11-03..2026-02-13). Goal: reduce overfit by keeping only robust hours/regimes and stricter gates.

adaptive_tuner_profiles.source_note: Manual clone of c4bb2197e651 with VWAP magnet enabled and replay-tuned VWAP strategy-combo defaults.

momentum.custom_entry_formula: has_l2_coverage and regime in ('TRENDING','MIXED') and confidence >= 55 and flow_score >= 52 and directional_consistency >= 0.25 and signed_aggression > -0.02
momentum.custom_exit_formula: (position_side == 'long' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.22 or flow_score < 43 or signed_aggression < -0.08 or bars_held >= 20)) or (position_side == 'short' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.22 or flow_score < 43 or signed_aggression > 0.08 or bars_held >= 20))

vwap_magnet.custom_entry_formula: has_l2_coverage and regime in ('TRENDING','MIXED') and confidence >= 58 and abs((price - vwap) / max(vwap, 0.0001) * 100) >= 0.55 and directional_consistency >= 0.25 and abs(signed_aggression) >= 0.01
vwap_magnet.custom_exit_formula: (position_side == 'long' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.30 or flow_score < 42 or signed_aggression < -0.09 or bars_held >= 18)) or (position_side == 'short' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.30 or flow_score < 42 or signed_aggression > 0.09 or bars_held >= 18))

vwap_magnet.custom_entry_formula: has_l2_coverage and regime in ('TRENDING','MIXED') and confidence >= 55 and abs((price - vwap) / max(vwap, 0.0001) * 100) >= 0.6 and rsi <= 68 and directional_consistency >= 0.3 and signed_aggression > -0.1
vwap_magnet.custom_exit_formula: (position_side == 'long' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.35 or flow_score < 40 or signed_aggression < -0.08 or (bars_held >= 18 and flow_score < 45))) or (position_side == 'short' and (position_pnl_pct <= -0.35 or flow_score < 40 or signed_aggression > 0.08 or (bars_held >= 18 and flow_score < 45)))

pullback.custom_entry_formula: has_l2_coverage and regime in ('TRENDING','MIXED') and adx >= 20 and rsi >= 40 and rsi <= 67 and flow_score >= 42 and signed_aggression > -0.02
pullback.custom_exit_formula: (position_side == 'long' and (position_pnl_pct >= 0.9 or signed_aggression < -0.06 or book_pressure < -0.08 or flow_score < 40)) or (position_side == 'short' and (position_pnl_pct >= 0.9 or signed_aggression > 0.06 or book_pressure > 0.08 or flow_score < 40)) or bars_held >= 18
